Live-action cinematic sequence, photoreal feature-film quality — not animation, not CGI-looking. A hooded mage slowly approaches a massive, restless griffon on a clifftop at sunset, trying to win its trust and calm it without harming himself or the animal. The sequence lingers on the mage in medium and close-up, with the griffon as his scene partner.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<image_1>>>: the fairy-tale forest valley location — dense dark-green forest to the horizon, a deep river canyon with drifting mist over the treetops, low golden sun, dusky pink and amber sunset sky. Controls geography, materials, atmosphere, and light only. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_2>>>: the griffon — eagle head and chest with iridescent shimmer in the breast feathers, hooked beak, tawny lion body, feathered wings, tufted tail, worn leather saddle. The size of a warhorse, with real bulk and muscle. Energetic, untamable, spirited and willful, barely holding still. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_3>>>: tall mage in his early 20s, around 190 cm, long-limbed and lean. Short tightly-curled bleached-blond hair, light mustache with a small soul-patch, brown eyes, calm and watchful. Wears an olive-green hooded cloak over a steel chainmail vest, a mustard-ochre under-robe, a leather satchel slung across the chest, and a silver pendant set with a green stone and a coiled serpent. Holds a pale wooden staff low in one hand; the other hand stays open and low. 100% matches the reference.

LOCATION MAP
A rocky cliff edge in the foreground, the vast forest canyon of <<<image_1>>> dropping away behind it to the horizon. Low golden sun on the screen-right horizon throwing warm rim light and long shadows; drifting mist in the canyon. Strong gusts move across the clifftop.
The griffon stands near the cliff edge, screen-right, three-quarters to camera, facing out over the valley. The mage approaches on foot from screen-left.

FORMAT MODE
Controlled four-segment sequence with HARD CUTS between segments. Real-time motion. No subtitles, no music.

SEGMENT 1 — WIDE, FULL HEIGHT OF BOTH (brief, establish scale)
First frame contains both: the griffon screen-right on the cliff edge in full, three-quarters to camera, and <<<image_3>>> at full height screen-left, mid-stride, hood up, staff low in one hand, the other palm open and low. Wide enough to read the griffon as the size of a warhorse and the mage small beside it, golden valley behind.
LENS: 84° classic wide, camera low on the clifftop, straight lines rectilinear, no fisheye.
Action (short): the mage takes one slow careful step in; the griffon fidgets — weight shifts, talons scrape rock, head jerks, wings half-flare and snap shut — eye on him. He stops. End state: a few meters between them.

SEGMENT 2 — MEDIUM, MAGE (longer, hero coverage)
First frame on <<<image_3>>> from the knees/waist up, screen-center, hood up, staff held low in one hand, the green pendant and chainmail catching light, the canyon golden behind; the griffon's shoulder and wing just in frame screen-right.
LENS: 47° standard normal, camera at eye level on the clifftop.
Action: he advances one slow, open step at a time, lowering the staff further and raising his free open palm toward the griffon; wind moves his cloak and hood. He freezes each time the animal twitches, then continues, reading it. End state: palm half-raised, close enough to reach.

SEGMENT 3 — CLOSE-UP, MAGE (longest, hold here)
First frame on <<<image_3>>>'s hooded face and shoulders filling the frame, blond curls and mustache catching warm rim light, eyes fixed off-screen-right on the griffon, the canyon soft and golden behind.
LENS: 29° short telephoto portrait, shallow depth of field.
Action: he breathes slow and even, a small steadying tilt of the head, micro-shifts of the eyes tracking the animal, lips closed; wind lifts the edge of his hood. Patient, unhurried, never lunging — he is waiting for the griffon to choose. End state: a faint, hopeful softening as the off-screen animal begins to settle.

SEGMENT 4 — TWO-SHOT, FIRST CONTACT
First frame contains both: the mage's open hand entering from screen-left and the griffon's lowered beak/cheek on screen-right, cliff and golden valley behind.
LENS: 47° standard normal, camera close on the clifftop.
Action: the griffon's restless head-tossing eases, it leans its head the last few centimeters, and his open palm rests gently on its cheek-feathers; wings settle, breathing slows. He keeps the touch light, staff still low in the other hand. End state: contact held, both still, wind moving over them. At least 0.5s held after contact.

PHYSICS
The griffon has real mass — heavy paws press and scrape the rock, talons catch stone, head and neck carry weight when they toss and lower, wings have inertia as they flare and fold. Feathers and mane flutter and ripple individually in the gusting wind; lion fur shifts. The mage's cloak, chainmail, satchel and hood move with the wind and his slow steps; real heel-to-toe weight transfer; the staff has weight; his free hand moves with controlled, unhurried weight, no jerk. Mist drifts through the canyon in depth layers.

LIGHTING
Moody golden-hour sunset key from the low sun on screen-right, warm amber rim light tracing the mage's blond hair and hood and the griffon's feathers against the dusky pink sky; deep shadowed forest below. Faces and the griffon's eye stay readable. Cinematic, atmospheric, not flat.

AUDIO
Wind across the clifftop, the griffon's restless feather-rustle, talon scrapes on rock, a low avian chirr and a single soft snort, the mage's quiet breath. No dialogue, no narration, no music, no subtitles.

STYLE
Photoreal live-action, 35mm filmic look, natural depth of field, realistic feather and fur dynamics, realistic motion blur, shallow grain, strong sense of physical mass and scale. No cartoon, no stylization, no CGI-looking surfaces.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Exactly one griffon (matching <<<image_2>>>) and one mage (matching <<<image_3>>>), identities and wardrobe stable across all four segments — bleached-blond hair, hood up, green serpent pendant, staff in one hand. The mage stays gentle and never harms or is harmed; the griffon is never struck or restrained by force. Hard cuts only, lens locked per segment, no drift inside a segment. Golden sun stays screen-right; left/right relationship preserved across cuts. The medium and close-up of the mage are the longest beats. No dialogue, no subtitles, no music. Sharp clarity, stable picture, no ghosting, no flicker.

Bob, a Greek warrior in armor that's visibly too small, charges in the Greek front line as the avalanche slams into the Trojan defenders. Clang, dust, screaming. He's terrified but committed — fighting clumsy and desperate, yet somehow winning, hungry to prove he belongs among the heroes. Single continuous action take, immersive medium-wide.

CHARACTER
<<<image_1>>>: early 20s, big soft-bodied guy, same face as , now a Greek hoplite. Armor visibly too small — breastplate won't close, helmet sits like a beanie and slips. Current state: dead-serious, wide-eyed, scared but committed, breathing hard. Action-critical: grips a short sword and shield (@prop_ON_shields_weapons_s3), swings clumsy but lands his blows and stays on his feet. Face 100% matches .

LOCATION MAP
Plains of Troy, ancient Greece, DAWN. Semi-desert to the horizon. Sky of old-painting clouds — heavy, gold at the edges, light punching through. FG: dust and clashing bodies. MG: Bob in the Greek line. BG: the dust wall of battle and the faint city wall far on the horizon. Greek avalanche charges screen-left-to-right; the Trojan enemy line braces from screen-right.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame is already inside the charge — no empty establishing field.
<<<image_1>>> runs FG-center, x 50%, y 58%, shield up, moving screen-right into the collision, helmet slipping over his brow.
<<<image_3>>> floods the frame around and behind him, FG-to-MG, x 0-60%, charging the same direction — Bob is one of them, mid-pack.
<<<image_4>>> braces and meets them from MG screen-right, x 60-100%, shields locked, the two masses about to slam.
Dust and weapons fill the lower third, y 75-100%.

OPTICS
35mm-equivalent, ~54 degrees, immersive. Medium-wide keeps Bob readable inside the avalanche while showing the scale of the clash. Deep enough focus to hold the colliding lines; Bob the sharpest figure.

CAMERA
Dynamic handheld energy, moving with the charge — tracking alongside and slightly behind Bob as the lines collide, then settling on him as he fights. Real urgency and shake, but Bob stays findable in frame. Eye-to-chest level in the chaos.

ACTION TIMING
0.0-1.5s: the two lines sprint together; Bob mid-pack, shield up, helmet slipping, dust rising.
1.5-4.0s: IMPACT — bodies, shields, and clang collide; Bob glances around wild-eyed, swings clumsy and desperate.
4.0-end: he blocks, shoves, and lands a winning blow, staying on his feet — breathing hard, still alive, a flash of disbelief that he's actually doing it.

PHYSICS
Real mass and momentum: the colliding lines hit with weight, shields jolt, dust kicks up in heavy clouds. Bob's oversized armor flops and shifts; the helmet really slides and he nudges it back. Sword and shield have heft; every swing has follow-through. Grounded, real-time, no floaty motion.

LIGHTING
Golden epic dawn, low sun raking across the plain, gold-edged clouds, hard light punching through dust. High contrast and crushed silhouette are acceptable here — rim-light the charging figures against the dust, keep Bob's wide eyes catching a glint of dawn so his fear and resolve still read.

AUDIO
No dialogue. Real battlefield wall of sound — clashing metal, shields, shouting, thudding feet, dust and wind. No music, no subtitles.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Bob's face 100% matches . His armor stays visibly too small with the slipping helmet throughout. The first visible frame is a CLOSE-UP on Bob's face, x 50%, y 50%, frozen in shock, eyes darting side to side at the chaos, the too-small helmet perched on top of his head. No empty establishing field.
As the shot develops, the frame widens: <<<image_4>>> floods past him from behind, surging screen-right; Bob falls to the back of the pack, FG-center, lumbering after them. <<<image_3>>> braces in MG screen-right, x 65-100%, shields locked, waiting for the impact.

OPTICS
Shot on an anamorphic camera. Begins as a close-up (tight on the face), then opens to a medium-wide (~35mm anamorphic, wide field) as the camera retreats with the charge. Anamorphic character: oval/elliptical bokeh, gentle horizontal stretch in the out-of-focus areas, soft anamorphic edge-blur and falloff, organic shallow-depth separation. Clean modern glass — no horizontal light streaks, no blue flare lines, no lens flare; keep the anamorphic blur and oval bokeh without any streaking artifacts. CAMERA

ACTION TIMING
0.0-1.5s: CLOSE-UP — Bob frozen in shock, eyes darting at the battle, fumbling the tiny helmet, trying to force it onto his head; it won't fit.

Wordless seduction beat from "Neural Net of Dreams," Scene 3 — the plain below Troy at dawn. Elena, a breathtakingly beautiful woman who believes every living being is in love with her and who hungers for power, stands high on the city wall among the nobility. She begins with her back to camera, then turns to reveal her face and begins to walk, with serene, predatory confidence. No dialogue. Above and behind, the sky holds heavy painterly clouds — the kind from old master paintings — golden along their edges, with shafts of dawn light breaking through as if a door opened above. Shallow dust haze hangs over the distant plain. <<<image_2>>> controls architecture, materials, atmosphere, and the warm painterly dawn backlight only; it does not control framing, camera angle, or extra figures. FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains <<<image_1>>>, standing with her back to camera at screen center, x 50%, y 45%, head and bare shoulders filling the frame. No empty establishing frame. We see the back of her copper-red curls, bare shoulder, and gown. Her face is intentionally hidden at the start and is revealed on her turn — this is a deliberate reveal beat, not an establishing drift. Body faces away into the depth toward the plain; she will rotate to her left to bring her face toward the lens, gaze settling off-axis toward the battlefield below at screen-left. Controlled two-segment sequence with one HARD CUT at 4.0s. Real-time motion. No subtitles, no music.
OPTICS
SEGMENT 1 = 29° short telephoto portrait lens character. Medium framing, head-and-shoulders to mid-back, face razor-sharp once revealed, background softens and compresses behind her.
SEGMENT 2 = 18° classic telephoto lens character. Tight emotional close-up, strong background compression, the Troy walls and golden clouds melt into soft warm bokeh, razor focus isolates her eyes and lips.
No lens drift inside any segment.
CAMERA
Handheld, operator-breathing rig at her eye level. Subtle living pulse: micro-settling, faint weight shift, gentle human correction, never digital jitter, never random shake. Camera holds on the shadow-warm side of her face.

SEGMENT 2 (4.0s–8.0s): close, camera retreats in a slow breathing pull as she begins to walk forward.

Wind streams toward camera-left: long copper curls swing across and lift off her face during the turn, the cream gown billows and trails with real cloth delay. Controlled four-segment sequence with HARD CUTS between segments. Real-time motion. No subtitles, no music.

Photoreal live-action, 35mm filmic look, natural depth of field, realistic feather and fur dynamics, realistic motion blur, shallow grain, strong sense of physical mass and scale. No cartoon, no stylization, no CGI-looking surfaces.

The mood is heavy, urgent and deadly serious; they place the scroll in his hand as if handing him the survival of the world, and bow to him in stately respect. Then he mounts his waiting griffon and they hurl themselves off the ledge, plunging straight DOWN the cliff toward a vast, deep, multi-tiered fairy-tale world far below.

The trio runs toward camera down the center; the four alien Guards pursue in the deep BG. Laser bolts streak both ways down the corridor and toward the lens.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame is CLOSE on the trio running toward camera, filling much of the frame: Sam center, x 50%, y 55%; the Alien Woman screen-right, x 66%, y 54%, twisting to fire back; the Gorilla screen-left, x 32%, y 52% (tallest, upright). The four alien Guards chase in the deep BG, soft. Laser bolts rip past the heroes and streak toward the lens in near-misses. No empty frame.

OPTICS
Shot on a 35mm ANAMORPHIC lens — natural, non-distorting rendering — wide open at the fastest aperture for VERY STRONG anamorphic character and HEAVY background blur. The trio razor-sharp; the four Guards, corridor, and bolts dissolve into very heavy soft anamorphic bokeh — big oval/elliptical bokeh, marked horizontal stretch, heavy edge-blur and falloff. Clean modern glass — no horizontal light streaks, no blue flare lines, no lens flare; keep the strong anamorphic blur and oval bokeh without any streaking artifacts.

CAMERA
Camera leads the trio held CLOSE — tight on them, filling the frame — dollying backward ahead of them so they run toward the lens. HARD handheld SHAKE. Laser bolts whip past close to the lens as near-misses. Steady, controlled pace — kinetic but not frantic; the trio always centered and readable.

ACTION TIMING
0.0-2.0s: close on the trio moving toward camera at a steady pace — Sam center, Alien Woman right (bust/rear jiggling), Gorilla left upright; the four Guards fire from behind.
2.0-4.0s: the Alien Woman twists and FIRES BACK, her laser bolts streaking down the corridor; bolts from both sides rip past close to camera in near-misses; the Gorilla hops, beats his chest and ROARS.
4.0-end: they keep moving at the lens, the four Guards pursuing, laser near-misses flashing past the camera.

PHYSICS
Real weight and momentum at a controlled pace: Sam lean; the Alien Woman's bust and rear bounce and jiggle with each stride, her oversized blaster kicking as she fires back; the Gorilla's 2 m bulk pounds upright, hopping, chest-beating and roaring. The four Guards run on their heels with mass. Laser bolts travel as visible beam-bolts, ripping past the heroes and streaking toward the lens, sparking off the walls. Real-time, grounded, no floaty motion.

LIGHTING
Glossy hard sci-fi corridor light — cool metal and glowing strip-lights — with warm motivated flashes from the laser fire punching across the trio and toward the lens. Faces readable; Sam's eyes behind the glasses catch light. No flat front light.

AUDIO
No dialogue. Future-chase sound — footsteps, laser fire cracks and whines ripping past the lens, the Gorilla's chest-beats and drawn-out ROAR, the Alien Woman's blaster, the alien Guards' pursuit, corridor hum. No music, no subtitles.

#1 TOP PRIORITY — THE GRIFFON'S WINGS ARE FOLDED SHUT (read first): through the whole dive the griffon's wings are FOLDED SHUT like a CLOSED UMBRELLA / folded fan, laid flat along its back with the tips to the tail — exactly like a GANNET or PEREGRINE knifing into a dive. It does NOT fly; it FALLS like a rigid spear/arrow, head-first straight down. No open wings, no wing surface, no flapping. This rule beats everything else.

#2 TOP PRIORITY — STARTING POSE (read first): in the FIRST FRAME Rudy and the griffon stand with their BACK / RUMP / TAIL to the ABYSS and their HEAD/FACE turned INWARD toward the temple and mages. They do NOT start facing the drop. Only after Rudy's sharp rein-pull does the griffon wheel 180° to face out over the abyss and drop. Start: back-to-abyss, facing the temple. Mandatory.

SCENE CONTEXT
Shot 1 is a MEDIUM-CLOSE on Rudy, who starts with his BACK to the abyss (facing the temple/mages). He gives a sharp, energetic, showy YANK OF THE REINS to the side and the griffon rears/wheels a fast 180° to face the drop, then instantly, briskly TIPS off the slope and plunges. On that beat a GENERAL/WIDE plan kicks in and the CAMERA rushes DOWN, catching up to Rudy and tucking in at his SHOULDER — we feel insane speed, wind whipping Rudy's clothes and the griffon's feathers, the griffon racing DOWN like an arrow at ~100 km/h. They accelerate through a thin CONDENSATION-CLOUD layer, and the wondrous view opens: MULTI-LEVEL GLOWING LAKES and a great RIFT (the lake matching the <<<7b13058c-5f80-4efb-83e8-8c93a050c3eb>>> reference), with skeletal fluorescent birds and dense neon poison-coloured flora and fauna. As it opens, Rudy — still hurtling down — lets out a FREE JOYOUS CRY and then LAUGHS loudly, as if free for the first time in his life; his breath catches (sharp deep chest breaths, as if doused with cold water). He falls as if about to dive into the water, only accelerating. Cut. Three shots joined by two hard cuts.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
21:9 anamorphic widescreen (2.39:1). Three shots, two hard cuts. Real-time motion. Live-action film plate. SFX + Rudy's scripted vocals only — no music, no subtitles.

EVENT (unplayed, it proceeds through him): the dream is cracking — his private rapture is invaded by something that should be impossible here, and reality is about to yank him out of it.
GOAL: first, to lose himself completely in the world he always wanted; then, to place the impossible sound and understand where it comes from.
MOTIVE (his fuel): he is utterly absorbed, drinking the beauty in; the wrong sound demands to be understood, because it clearly intrudes where it should be impossible.
OBSTACLE: the voice's source stays hidden — it seems to come from everywhere at once — and his certainty that this world is real begins to crack.

— ACTING TASK — RUDY (the only performer; the work lives in his eyes; he stays silent, mouth closed throughout) —
EVENT (unplayed, it proceeds through him): the dream is cracking — his private rapture is invaded by something that should be impossible here, and reality is about to yank him out of it.
GOAL: first, to lose himself completely in the world he always wanted; then, to place the impossible sound and understand where it comes from.
MOTIVE (his fuel): he is utterly absorbed, drinking the beauty in; the wrong sound demands to be understood, because it clearly intrudes where it should be impossible.
OBSTACLE: the voice's source stays hidden — it seems to come from everywhere at once — and his certainty that this world is real begins to crack.
TACTIC (eye-work): savor with soft, drinking-in eyes; the instant the dubious sound reaches him, the eyes snap alert and start hunting — flicking around the open sky, checking near then far for the speaker; with the source still hidden, the search narrows and lands, disbelieving, on the lens/us — both eyes locking dead-on camera, reading us like "where is this coming from? who is watching?" — and then the ground drops out of him.
Moment to moment:
— savoring: eyes soft and wide, drinking in the glowing world, a small awed smile.
— the dubious off-screen sounds hit: the smile drops, the eyes snap alert — a clear, sharp shift as he is pulled out of the bliss.
— the search: eyes dart around the open air, near then far, brows knitting, small puzzled head-turns, hunting the source, mouth closed.
— the realization: the searching lands on the lens — both eyes lock dead-on camera, baffled and uncomprehending, as it dawns that the sound is coming from there, from us.
— the drop: reality yanks him straight down out of the cloak, and the camera plunges with him.
(Safety: eyes stay alive and engaged throughout, natural blink cadence; mouth stays closed and silent the whole time.)

本片没有"停住不动"这回事，只有更小的动作。台词之前、台词之后、以及任何一个停顿，人物都在做一件具体的、幅度很小的事——身体基本停在原地，但从不定格。

呼吸——打过仗的人呼吸是乱的、深的、不匀的，肩与胸持续起伏；冷空气里白气一团一团地出来，节奏不规律，偶尔憋住半秒再放。
重心——脚在泥里持续微调：一只脚跟抬起半寸又落下、身体极小幅度地换重心、脚下的泥被压得往下沉一点、发出很轻的黏声。
手——握刀的手指在柄上一次次重新收紧、松开、再收紧；空着的那只手手指开合，因为冷、也因为还在抖。
互相照看——两个人持续用余光检查对方：视线极快地扫一下对方的手、对方的重心、对方的呼吸，确认对方还站得住、需不需要立刻上手；扫完立刻收回，身体保持随时能动的状态。这不是"看"，这是"值守"。
不自觉的——吞咽一下；咬肌动一下又松开；小臂用过度了在轻微发抖，于是把手按在腿上压住；用小臂而不是手背擦一下眼睛。
环境——风持续吹动阵羽织的下摆、绳带与髷边的碎发，人跟着做极小的抵抗与调整。
禁止：任何一秒的定格；两个人同时静止；说完话之后不动地站着等下一句；空洞的对视；只有嘴在动而身体是静止的。
